scientific_integrity: The all-population forcing-horizon formula follows from an infinite-horizon three-machine invariant, an explicit four-machine five-chore adversary, an exact exhaustive four-machine four-arrival certificate, and a two/three-arrival argument for every larger population. No external independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only identical unit-size chores under nonempty eligibility constraints are covered.
The lower bounds require an adversary observing previous choices; they do not cover known future eligibility sets or an oblivious adversary.
The four-arrival positive boundary is established by fully specified finite enumeration; no numerical evidence is extended to unbounded horizons.
Unindexed equivalent small-case results cannot be categorically ruled out.
title: Sharp population and arrival thresholds for online unit-chore \(\mathrm{Prop1}\) with eligibility constraints
